development_evidence: Trigger choices use only the already consumed v1 comparison. The v2 holdout was frozen before this policy was implemented or executed.

arms.direct: One hybrid retrieval and grounded llama3.2:3b answer without support review.
arms.specialist: The existing context recovery plus qwen3.5:9b support-review pipeline.
arms.cascade: Run direct first. Run the unchanged specialist arm only when one of the frozen deterministic triggers fires; otherwise return direct.

primary_metrics: automated pass count over all 30 cases
decision_rule: Adopt the cascade only if it has no fewer automated passes than direct, preserves all direct missing-evidence passes, and uses fewer chat calls than always-specialist. A quality tie is reported as a cost tradeoff, not an improvement.
analysis_rules: No trigger, threshold, label, source snapshot, prompt, model or retrieval setting may be changed after seeing v2 outcomes.
Cascade cost is the sum of direct and specialist measurements on fallback cases because production would run them sequentially.
The same frozen direct and specialist outputs may be composed into the cascade because the trigger reads only direct output and fixed traces.
Report paired per-case outcomes and limitations; do not claim statistical significance from 30 cases.
Do not use this v2 holdout again to tune a v2 policy.
